description: Lua integer shift: logical left for a positive count, logical right for a negative count, 0 when the count is 64 or more in magnitude (luaV_shiftl)
notes: Lua 5.4.7, luaV_shiftl (lvm.c), with lua_Integer = int64_t and NBITS = 64; the intop() macro is spelled as casts to uint64_t. Written by us from the function. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: two branches, a select and a phi: 13 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
